senses.gloss: m. pl.(b. h.; cmp. מָהָה)water, fluid; secretion; solution. Constr. מֵי; pl. מֵימוֹת, constr. מֵימֵי.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:20">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>גלגל העין שדומה למ׳</he> the eye-ball which (in restlessness) resembles water, v. <cite ref="C00871"><he>גַּלְגַּל</he></cite>.

Par. VIII, 9 המ׳ המוכים וכ׳ smitten waters (springs or lakes formed through a catastrophe, v. Snh. l. c.). Ib. המ׳ המכזבים, v. כָּזַב; a. v. fr.—מ׳ ראשונים, מ׳ אחרונים &c., v. respective determinants.—מֵי פירות juice of fruits (wine, date-honey, &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 3:2">Meg. III, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:5">Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ</cite> bot.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 3a:15">Ḥag. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵימֶיךָ אנו שותין</he> we drink thy water, i.e. we depend on thy teaching; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:4">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵימֵיהֶן אנו שותין</he>; <cite ref="Horayot 14a">Hor. 14ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Taanit 16a:14">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מימות וכ׳</he> all the waters of the world; a. fr.
